sloka: ततस्तु वेगवांस्तस्य गिरेर्गिरिनिभः कपिः ।निपपात महेन्द्रस्य शिखरे पादपाकुले ।। 5.57.30 ।।।।
transliteration: tatastu vegavāṁstasya girergirinibhaḥ kapiḥ ।nipapāta mahendrasya śikhare pādapākule ।। 5.57.30 ।।।।

translations.english: Overwhelmed with immeasurable joy, Hanuman descended from the sky like the mountain with its wings cut off and dropped on the bank of a mountain stream.
